About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and runs anthropic.com and claude.com, brand web surfaces where most of the world meets Claude and Anthropic for the first time. They carry our research, product launches, policy work, and brand, and they ship at the pace of a fast-moving company.

You'll manage a small, senior team of web engineers, owning the full stack behind our marketing web: CMS architecture, the publishing pipeline, the design system in code, and the campaign and launch experiences tied to model and product releases. This role sits inside Brand Creative and partners closely with design, editorial, marketing, and product growth engineering. We want a player-coach: comfortable setting technical direction without an existing playbook, staying close to the code and the launches, and building the tooling that lets designers and editors publish without an engineer in the loop.

Responsibilities 

  • Manage and grow the team: coach, hire, and set the bar for craft and reliability
  • Own the technical roadmap for anthropic.com and claude.com: CMS architecture, publishing workflow, performance, SEO health, localization, the production design system, deploy pipeline, on-call, and incident response
  • Run launch engineering for model, product, and campaign moments, shipping high-quality pages on tight, shifting timelines without heroics
  • Build the brand tooling layer: internal tools, integrations, and Claude-in-the-loop workflows that let designers, writers, and marketers publish safely without engineering as a bottleneck
  • Partner with design and editorial on creative technology, data visualizations, interactive explainers, campaign experiences, that need real engineering, not a template
  • Align web engineering work with Marketing, Product, Comms, and core Engineering, and say no to what doesn't move brand and business goals

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 10+ years in software engineering, 5+ managing engineers, with that time spent as an engineering manager inside a marketing, brand, or design engineering organization specifically, not just a product engineering one
  • Owned a high-traffic marketing or brand web surface end to end: CMS, frontend, infrastructure, and the publishing workflow around it
  • Strong frontend depth yourself, TypeScript, React, modern CSS, a modern headless CMS, and a real preference for staying close to the code
  • Built tooling that made non-engineers faster and safer, with a concrete story of what changed
  • Shipped under real launch pressure with cross-functional partners, without dropping the quality bar
  • Comfortable operating at the seam between Design, Marketing, and Engineering
  • Deep interest in AI and excitement about putting Claude into the build and publish loop itself, not just on the page

Strong candidates may also have

  • Held a Head of Web Engineering or equivalent platform lead title at a product company
  • Built localization and multi region web infrastructure
  • Come from a company where brand and product web sat close together: design tools, productivity, or developer tools
  • Led design systems or component library work that shipped to production

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As a Commercial Account Executive, Mid-Market, you’ll be the primary point of contact for prospective and existing customers in our mid-market segment, helping organizations modernize how they plan, build, secure, and ship software with GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform.   • Focus on customer accounts with 250 to 1,999 employees, managing the spectrum of project sizes and complexity within the mid-market segment.
  • Articulate the value of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform to Mid-Market prospects and customers, tailoring messaging to their business and technical needs.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing win/loss insights, updating the sales handbook, and being a clear voice of the customer into the product via our public issue tracker.

About the Team
Platform Partnerships builds and grows the relationships that extend OpenAI products through the world’s most important technology platforms. The team works across Product, Engineering, Research, Go-to-Market, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Policy, and Operations to turn partner opportunities into durable product experiences and business outcomes.
We’re hiring a Partner Manager, Channel Monetization to help build, scale, and manage a portfolio of strategic platform and monetization partnerships. You will drive day-to-day strategy and execution, help shape joint roadmaps and commercial opportunities, and translate shared ambition into measurable adoption, usage, revenue, distribution, and product impact.
This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for a skilled generalist who can move between partnership strategy and detailed execution. You will own day-to-day execution across priority relationships, collaborate with senior partnership leads and cross-functional teams, create structure where playbooks are still emerging, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and step into the product, commercial, and operating details required to move work forward.

In this role, you will:
• Drive day-to-day partnership strategy and execution across priority partners, working closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Go-to-Market, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Policy, and Operations to align roadmaps and deliver outcomes.

• Own a portfolio of strategic partnerships as businesses: set direction, prioritize opportunities, and drive outcomes aligned with OpenAI’s product and company goals.

• Contribute to multi-year expansion strategies and joint plans that connect product roadmaps, commercial opportunities, go-to-market motions, and measurable outcomes.

• Support complex deal execution and commercial negotiations from partner evaluation through product integration, launch, expansion, and renewal.

• Operate as a cross-functional driver, aligning internal teams and external partners around clear priorities, owners, dependencies, launch readiness, and decisions.

• Build trusted executive and working-level relationships across both organizations, creating direct communication, shared accountability, and thoughtful pushback when priorities conflict.

• Establish and run partner operating cadences, including roadmap reviews, business reviews, planning sessions, launch-readiness reviews, issue resolution, and escalation paths.

• Translate partner needs, technical constraints, customer feedback, and market signals into clear product, ecosystem, and go-to-market recommendations.

• Define success metrics and communicate performance, risks, tradeoffs, and opportunities through concise, decision-ready materials for internal stakeholders and executives.

• Resolve blockers with urgency and turn successful first-of-kind work into simple, reusable playbooks and operating models as the portfolio scales.

You might thrive in this role if you:
• 10+ years of experience in business development, product partnerships, product, or related technology roles.

• Proven experience supporting or leading complex strategic partnerships from 0 to 1 and through scale, including technical or product integrations and measurable commercial, adoption, distribution, or product outcomes.

• Strong product and technical judgment, with the ability to work credibly with Product and Engineering on APIs, integrations, developer platforms, data flows, agents, or emerging products.

• Experience supporting or structuring complex commercial and technical agreements while balancing near-term outcomes with long-term strategic value.

• Strong cross-functional operating skills and experience aligning Product, Engineering, Research, Go-to-Market, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Policy, and Operations to execute complex initiatives.

• Strong strategic judgment and problem-solving skills, using data and sound judgment to navigate ambiguity, prioritize competing opportunities, and make tradeoffs.

• Clear communication across executive, technical, commercial, and operational audiences, including through high-quality written plans and decision materials.

• Ability to build trust, resolve conflict, and manage expectations across functions and company boundaries without relying on formal authority.

• High agency, low ego, adaptability, and exceptional follow-through; willing to do the detailed work required to move an outcome forward.

• Experience operating in a high-growth company or a scaled technology platform is preferred.
